rules.name: Missing content-security-policy
rules.remediation: Constrain script/resource origins with a tested Content-Security-Policy.

rules.name: Missing strict-transport-security
rules.remediation: Enable HSTS on HTTPS after confirming all required hosts support HTTPS.

rules.name: Missing x-content-type-options
rules.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

rules.name: Missing x-frame-options
rules.remediation: Use CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options to restrict framing.

rules.name: Missing referrer-policy
rules.remediation: Set a deliberate Referrer-Policy, such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

rules.name: Missing permissions-policy
rules.remediation: Restrict browser features that this application does not require.

rules.name: Missing cross-origin-opener-policy
rules.remediation: Consider same-origin opener isolation where compatible.

rules.name: Missing cross-origin-resource-policy
rules.remediation: Choose a resource policy appropriate to intended cross-origin use.

rules.name: Permissive Content-Security-Policy
rules.remediation: Review unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval and wildcard sources; test a tighter policy.

rules.name: Session-like cookie without Secure
rules.remediation: Set Secure on session cookies and serve the application over HTTPS.

rules.name: Session-like cookie without HttpOnly
rules.remediation: Set HttpOnly unless client-side access is explicitly required.

rules.name: Cookie SameSite requires review
rules.remediation: Choose Lax or Strict where possible; SameSite=None requires Secure.

rules.name: Broad cookie domain or path
rules.remediation: Restrict Domain and Path to the minimum application scope.

rules.name: Wildcard CORS origin observed
rules.remediation: Confirm that this resource is intentionally public; wildcard alone is not a vulnerability.

rules.name: Wildcard origin with credentials
rules.remediation: Use an explicit trusted origin allowlist. Browsers reject wildcard credentialed responses.

rules.name: Potential unsafe credentialed origin reflection
rules.remediation: Validate Origin against an exact trusted allowlist; manually verify sensitive authenticated impact.

rules.name: Potential source-control metadata exposure
rules.remediation: Remove source-control metadata from the public web root.

rules.name: Potential environment-file exposure
rules.remediation: Deny public access to environment files; investigate exposure and rotate affected secrets if confirmed.

rules.name: Directory listing observed
rules.remediation: Disable unintended directory indexes.

rules.name: Verbose server error observed
rules.remediation: Return generic errors externally and retain diagnostics only in restricted logs.

rules.name: Source map reference exposed
rules.remediation: Review production source maps for unintended source or metadata disclosure.

rules.name: Server technology banner disclosed
rules.remediation: Minimize unnecessary version banners; a banner does not prove a vulnerable version.

rules.name: Sensitive-looking response fields
rules.remediation: Review authorization and data minimization for the observed response fields.

rules.name: Expired TLS certificate
rules.remediation: Renew the certificate and verify the full deployment chain.

rules.name: TLS certificate hostname mismatch
rules.remediation: Deploy a certificate whose subject alternative names cover the target hostname.

rules.name: TLS certificate validation failed
rules.remediation: Verify trust, certificate validity, and intermediate-chain deployment.

rules.name: Weak negotiated TLS or certificate algorithm
rules.description: Weak negotiated TLS or certificate algorithm
rules.remediation: Use TLS 1.2+ and modern certificate signatures/key sizes.
